highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 is the stable Skia m150 release with new filtering and diagnostics APIs.
highlights_body: It adds image-filter and overdraw helpers, improves surface canvas access, and promotes remaining v3 obsolete APIs to compile errors.

breaking.title: Remaining v3 obsolete APIs removed
breaking.body: APIs previously marked obsolete before v4 are now compile errors. Replace obsolete members with their recommended v4 alternatives before upgrading.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 150 and includes subsequent upstream maintenance fixes.
Adds crop and empty image filters plus an overdraw color filter for rendering diagnostics.
Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds for efficient culling decisions.
Avoids the slow raster blur path that caused incorrect results for small blur sigmas.
SKSurface now caches its Canvas wrapper, reducing repeated wrapper allocation during drawing.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Promoted obsolete v3 APIs, fixed raster blur behavior, and optimized SKSurface canvas access

preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.150 line with the Skia m150 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added the HarfBuzz update and the v4 API transition work.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 added image-filter, overdraw, and fast-bounds APIs while finalizing rendering fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz library to 14.2.1 for text shaping consumers.
